document: Task D F2 Cabinet Power Reference Plan
purpose: Construct a cabinet-power reference whose statistical object matches the quantity used by the replay cabinet constraint: total concurrent reconstructed cabinet power. No scheduling-policy comparison is executed in Task D.

F1.name: frozen legacy reference
F1.formula: Q_F1,c = percentile_99({P_job,c for all qualifying jobs j})
F1.weighting: event-weighted (job-count-weighted) P99 of individual job-cabinet power contributions
F1.note: One observation per qualifying job regardless of duration. Used in all sc0-sc54 results.

F2.name: corrected time-weighted total P99
F2.P_c_t: P_c(t) = sum_j P_job,c(t) — the total concurrent reconstructed cabinet power at time t
F2.method: Exact piecewise-constant event-driven process over selected-date calendar support. Weights are exact interval durations.
F2.zero_states: Zero observed load during a supported calendar interval is an observed state and is included.

F3.name: corrected event-weighted total P99 (diagnostic only)
F3.formula: Q_F3,c = P99 of post-event power states at unique event timestamps
F3.method: Event timestamps are all unique job-start and job-end times inside supported intervals. Post-event power state sampled once per unique timestamp. Ordinary (unweighted) P99. No scheduling simulation.

support_definition.collection_dates: All unique date_dir values in the parquet; 135 dates expected
support_definition.intervals: Each date d -> [d 00:00:00 UTC, d+1 00:00:00 UTC). Adjacent dates merged into contiguous blocks.
support_definition.job_clipping: observed_interval = [start_time, end_time) intersect support_union; unsupported gaps contribute zero duration
support_definition.zero_states: Zero observed load during an actually selected support interval is an observed state included in F2 distribution
support_definition.terminology: observed reconstructed concurrent cabinet power (not measured/actual/physical/facility-meter)

weighted_quantile_convention.definition: For sorted power states (P_k, duration_k): normalize by total calendar support duration; F2 P99 = smallest P such that cumulative time weight at or below P is >= 0.99 of total supported duration

stop_conditions: F1 cannot be reproduced within 1e-6 tolerance
